worktree_behavior: Linked worktree (git worktree add): core.hooksPath=.githooks is shared via common .git/config; when the worktree checkout contains .githooks/, pre-commit fires. run-gates uses git rev-parse --show-toplevel → the linked worktree root (not main tree); $ROOT/.githooks and $ROOT/harness resolve correctly; hardroll from linked worktree BLOCKS (wt_block=1). Hole: if the worktree checkout lacks .githooks/ (old rev / deleted), hooks silently no-op (V9 confirmed live). No V14 cross-bind bug found in this impl (uses show-toplevel, not $0-dir).
failopen_findings: rm -rf .githooks while core.hooksPath=.githooks → git commit of hardroll succeeds (no hook process). Repro: install-hooks.sh; rm -rf .githooks; git add evil.py; git commit
branch not named main → skill-review skipped (declared-as-bootstrap wording) but still fails open for skills on master/trunk. Repro: git branch -m main master; commit skill

PATH without python → fail-CLOSED (gate-hook: no python). broken .venv/bin/python preferred → fail-CLOSED. missing scripts/skill-review-gate.sh while main exists → bash fails → fail-CLOSED (rc=1). harness raise RuntimeError → real run-gates fail-CLOSED (naive swallows — red-test discriminative).
